summary: An authenticated browser subscribes to one live host generation, renders live-only terminal output and sends terminal input and resize controls through the account-scoped relay.
trigger: A signed-in user selects an online host in the browser workspace.

steps.action: Open an account-scoped WebSocket, negotiate relay protocol v1 and subscribe to the selected host ID and generation.
Authorize and route subscription and RPC messages through the host relay to the matching online host; delivery credits bound outstanding frames.
Serve metadata and remote session/terminal control requests, while publishing live output and session events through the relay.
Forward live terminal output to the subscribed browser and store structured Pi events in private history; do not persist terminal bytes.
Decode terminal output into the matching xterm pane and send sequenced terminal input or debounced resize only while the selected host connection is active.
